included.title: What's in every installation
included.intro: The bits you never see are the bits that go wrong. Tap a part.

parts.title: The electrical work
parts.body: Done by Strathdee Electrical Pty Ltd, Lic. 127921C — the controls, the wiring between indoor and outdoor units, and the sub-mains back to your switchboard. Andrew is a qualified electrician, so it isn't subbed out to a stranger.

parts.title: Refrigeration piping
parts.body: Refrigeration-grade copper that meets both the manufacturer's standard and Australian Standard AS1571. Suction and liquid lines are both insulated with industry-approved insulation.

parts.title: Colour matching
parts.body: Pipe and wiring running down an external wall gets encased in colour bonding, matched as close as we can to your existing downpipe or wall colour. It's why people say the install suits the house.

parts.title: Drains and the drip tray
parts.body: Condensate runs out through PVC into the roof gutter. Under the fan coil we fit a galvanised drip tray that drains separately through the eaves — so a blocked drain shows up outside instead of through your ceiling.

parts.title: The outdoor unit
parts.body: Mounted on a poly slab beside the building with about 100mm of breathing space behind it. Council rules and the Noise Pollution Act decide where it can go; we recommend, and the final call is yours.

parts.title: Outlets and return air
parts.body: Square multi-directional, round, floor or wall outlets, all adjustable for summer and winter. Return air comes back through a hinged grille with a washable filter, usually in the hallway.

_source.aboutText: Lower Mountains Air Conditioning are experts in what we do – after all, we have been operating since 1988. The company originally opened in Blaxland East. Since that time, it's relocated to Smith Street, Emu Plains and then again to a larger premises in Russell Street, Emu Plains where we remain today. We do however, service a wide range of locations in Sydney such as Penrith and the Blue Mountains. We are proud to be dealers of six major brands: Mitsubishi Electric, Panasonic, LG, Daikin, Actron Air and Braemar. And service any brand, even if it wasn't our installation. Andrew and Anthea are the owners of Strathdee Electrical, a family-owned business now in its third generation, handed down from Andrew's grandfather since 1956. Andrew is a qualified electrician and experienced refrigeration, air conditioning and electrical technician. He has extensive experience in the field, installing and servicing domestic, industrial and commercial air conditioning, refrigeration equipment and electrical work. Andrew and Anthea are responsible for the general running of the business including on-site sales and quotations. In addition to this, they also participate in servicing and trouble-shooting any technical difficulties in most brands. They are supported by a reliable, loyal and qualified team of 14 staff including tradespeople, apprentices, trade assistants and friendly office staff. Please feel welcome to come visit our showroom to discuss options and ask any questions you may have. We are based in Emu Plains, proudly provide professional air conditioner installation and servicing across South Penrith, Blaxland, Springwood, Kingswood, Glenbrook, Cranebrook, Katoomba, Glenmore Park and the Blue Mountains.
